scheme_name: Medical Assistance for the Treatment of Critical Illness
other_conditions: Worker must be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW).
Worker or family member must be undergoing treatment for a serious illness or critical medical condition.
Benefit can be availed only after 26 July 2014.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 for medical treatment of serious illnesses.
